verses.text: Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Abiam reyal t'a Judá.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix sb'eyb'alej chukal winh icha ix sk'ulej winh smam winh. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Maj sk'anab'ajej Jehová winh t'a smasanil sk'o'ol icha sk'ulejnak winhaj rey David, haton winh smam icham winh.
Palta yujto xajan winhaj rey David chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' maj satkanel yinhtilal winh. Ixto ochkan yinhtilal winh chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén. Hanhejtona' ix skolkanel jun chonhab' chi' Jehová,

yujto te wach' yutejnak sb'a winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh. Manh yik'nakokel spensar winh t'a tas yalnak Jehová chi', anhej wal smul winh ochnak haton yuj tas ajnak smilan winhaj Urías hitita winh.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' winhaj Jeroboam chi', icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Roboam smam winh. Ha yab'ixal winhaj Abiam chi' yet' masanil tas sk'ulejnak winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Asa ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Asa, ix scha'el yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, a wal yik 20 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam chi' reyal t'a Israel.
Ha winhaj Asa chi', 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun chichim winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.
Te wach' tas ix sk'ulej winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winhaj rey David smam icham winh.

Ix spechel masanil heb' winh winak winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', haton heb' winh sk'ulan ajmulal yet' yetwinakil t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'och ejmelal. Masanil juntzanh yechel komon Dios ix sb'o heb' smam yicham winh, ix laj satpaxel winh.

Ix yik'el sniwanil yelk'och ix snun chichim winh, haton ix Maaca. Ix schekpax winh mak'jokpoj jun yechel Asera yajb'entak yak'nak b'o ix snun chichim chi', ix schekan nhusjoktz'a winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el winh masanil juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, palta te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix yak'anpaxkanoch k'e'en oro winh yet' k'e'en plata b'aj sik'chajkan tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' ix yak'kan winh smam winh yet' pax juntzanh ix sb'o winh.
Aynhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ix kot winhaj Baasa yak' owal t'a Judá, ix och ijan winh sb'o'an scuartel t'a chonhab' Ramá, yik smakan b'e winh yik wach' manhxa mach syal sk'och t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi', haxo winhaj Asa chi' ix ik'anelta masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata sik'b'iltokan t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a spalacio winh. Ix schekanb'at heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yik sb'at yak'ankan k'e'en chi' heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco, haton winh yuninal winhaj Tabrimón, yixchikin winhaj Hezión. Ha yet' k'e'en tumin chi', ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik:

Ko b'o junok ko trato, icha sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam kicham. Tik swak'b'at k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata in silab'ok t'ayach. Ak' lajwok a trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yik ol yaktej winh yak'an owal wet'ok, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Ben-adad chi' tas ix yalb'at winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' soldado winh yak' owal t'a yol yik Israel. Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik ix yak' ganar heb' soldado winh chi': Ijón, Dan, Abel-bet-maaca yet' masanil Cineret yet' masanil smakb'en Neftalí.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Baasa icha chi', ix yaktan winh sb'o'ank'e chonhab' Ramá, ix meltzaj winh t'a chonhab' Tirsa.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' winh aj Judá winhaj rey Asa chi', manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ix yik'ankot jantak k'e'en k'e'en heb' yet' te te', haton juntzanh chi' wan yak'anoch winhaj Baasa yik sb'o'ank'e chonhab' Ramá chi'. Haxo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e scuartel winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a chonhab' Geba t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a chonhab' Mizpa.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Asa, juntzanh owal ix yak' ganar winh, masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ix sb'ok'e winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Haxo yik ichamxo winh, ix och jun yab'il t'a yok winh.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham. Haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Josafat ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Nadab yuninal winhaj Jeroboam yak'an reyal t'a Israel, chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Palta haxo winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yinhtilal Isacar ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Nadab chi'. Ayik ix yak'an owal winhaj Nadab yet' heb' soldado Israel t'a chonhab' Gibetón, t'a yol yik heb' filisteo, hata' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Baasa chi'. Yuj chi' ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa chi' yak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Anhej wal yik ix och winh reyal chi', ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh, pilan ix cham heb' yuj winh, manhxa junok heb' ix kani, icha yalnakkan winhaj Ahías schekab' Jehová aj Silo.
Ix uji jun tik yuj smul winhaj Jeroboam ix yak'ochi ayik ix skuchb'anb'at heb' yetisraelal winh t'a chukal. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzajkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Nadab yet' masanil tas ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix ochnhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yak'an reyal t'a Israel, t'a chonhab' Tirsa. 24 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.
